lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: Voter intimidation: threatening a voter about how to vote or whether to vote. Offering money or goods in exchange for a vote. Campaigning within 100 metres of a polling station on election day.

lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: If you see any of these, you come here. That is what this station is for.
